currentParagraphText: “Alright, I guess,” Jake sighed. He still didn’t like the notion that those around him always had to consider if people got close to them genuinely or just as a way to get to Jake. Maybe he was just projecting, as Jake didn’t like it himself that a lot wanted to get close to him simply because he was the Chosen of the Malefic Viper.
